title: fix(spec): an action's operation: 'delete' refusal names the script and flow routes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"hotlong"} -->
_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzSEfdkEPm9YGfc3wYraC2vqA)_

Fixes #37775

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：搭建者（智能体或人）给动作写「删除当前记录」被拒时，拒绝信息里会说清该怎么做：用以操作者本人身份运行的流程动作。
- 为什么做：云端智能体效果专题的搭建线，发票场景里智能体被拒两次后放弃了「删明细行」动作，丢了分。
- 出错会怎样：只改了拒绝文字，拒绝本身和错误种类不变，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes
`operation: 'delete'` on an action stays refused with the same issue code (`invalid_value`). The message now ends with the working route: a `type: 'flow'` action naming an autolaunched flow that deletes the record. The flow runs as the caller, so the caller's delete permission applies. The script route is deliberately not named: a script action body runs elevated (`isSystem`, see `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/script-runner.ts` and `body-doors.ts`), so a delete there would skip the caller's delete permission and sharing (L1 review).

Premise check on `origin/main` 56c9cae6: the refusal is at `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:1698` and its assertion at `action-row-update.test.ts:287`, as the card says. No other file pins the sentence.

Files to read first: `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` (the `operation` error map), then the test.

## Tests
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/ui/action-row-update.test.ts`: 32 passed. The existing case keeps its `code` + first-sentence assertions, adds a `toContain` check for the flow route and a `not.toContain` check that no script route is suggested.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- Whole `@objectstack/spec` suite on a fresh `--ignore-scripts` install: the first run had 117 files fail to load because the generated `src/migrations/registry.ts` did not exist yet (it is generated mid-run); re-running those 116 test files after `pnpm gen:migration-registry`: 115 passed, 1 failed. The one is `scripts/def-key-collisions.test.ts` (`Cannot find module …/restored-limb/node_modules/.pnpm/tsx…/cli.mjs`, a copied tree without tsx), unrelated to this diff; CI's `Test Core` is the verdict.

## Acceptance notes
- The semantic upgrade entry `18.ui-page-action-row-operation-declared.ts` still says "A row delete is the object's own delete affordance" without the route. Left as is: it is shipped upgrade text, and this card is the refusal message only.

## Verification
`node -e "import('@objectstack/spec').then(m=>console.log(m.ActionSchema.safeParse({name:'x',label:'X',operation:'delete'}).error.issues.find(i=>i.path[0]==='operation').message))"` after a spec build: the message ends with the flow route and names no script route.
